original_value: Kingston UV500 - solid state drive - 120 GB - SATA 6Gb/s. Description: The Kingston UV500 SSD is a reliable and efficient solution to store multimedia files. This mSATA drive offers a high-speed data transfer rate of 6 Gb/s for heavy data backups. It provides a storage space of 120 GB to cover basic storage requirements. Kingston’s UV500 family of solid-state drives dramatically improves the responsiveness of your existing system with incredible boot, loading, and transfer times. This SSD enables ultra-responsive multi-tasking and ensures an overall faster system.
